topic: Birds and sky life (SC-BIRD): 3D models, flight silhouettes, bird sounds, morphology, GPS/3D tracks, papers and reference code
note: Guide: docs/research/scenery-investigations/SC-BIRD-00/README.md. Local copies live in the gitignored references/birds/ (reference only until a licence is adopted). Every local sha256 was re-verified 2026-10-24 (298 files). Verdicts: adopt = permissive licence verified on the source page; candidate = usable but needs review (quality, licence conflict, preview); restricted = CC-BY-SA or FAL share-alike; reference = study only. Audio files are Freesound HQ previews (lossy OGG) unless 'is_preview' is false; none was auditioned. Tags in 'extracted': [calc] our extraction from open data, [WF] quoted from the paper via web fetch, [inferred, U] species identity guessed.
